name: Richland County, SC
findings: Richland County has 1,776 nonprofit organizations. 779 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 632 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Richland County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
